channel.title: Skeletonic Stylus 2.0 — Modern CSS, 7.7 KB gzip
channel.description: Skeletonic Stylus 2.0 — OKLCH colours, native @layer, CSS Grid, container queries, view transitions. Class-based, JS-free, WCAG 2.2 AA, 7.7 KB gzip / 6.7 KB brotli.

item.title: Aan de slag met Skeletonic Stylus

item.title: About Skeletonic Stylus
item.description: Skeletonic Stylus is an open-source Stylus CSS library for accessible, fast, modular UI styling.
